title: 第11章 收割灵稻第12章 千两百斤
content_zh:
;;
半夜醒来，陈平睡不着了。
疼。
窝棚的草铺冰冷。
陈平蜷缩在上面，浑身酸疼。
后背被鞭子抽破的地方，火辣地疼。
肩膀被背篓带子磨破的皮，结了痂又裂开，黏在衣服上，一动就扯着疼。
手上的伤口多，割草的刀口，搬东西的擦伤，混着污泥。
他闭着眼，却睡不着。
脑子阵痛。
身体和精神都疲惫。
再这样下去，他可能会死。
以前没有玉佩的时候，日子也苦，但咬牙硬撑，勉强能完成活计，不至于天天挨鞭子。
自从得了玉佩，尤其是频繁进出空间，整个人的精神就像被抽干了。
白天干活，手脚发软，反应慢，动作就慢了。
割的草少了，背的慢了，清理猪圈也不利索。
监工的鞭子抽下来，他连躲的力气都没有。
王管事那张脸越来越阴沉，骂得也难听。
那几个壮汉杂役更是把脏活累活推给他，稍有不满，拳脚就上来。
身上的伤，新伤叠旧伤。

他知道自己陷入了一个循环。
进空间消耗精神——精神差导致干活慢挨打受伤——身体伤痛又加剧精神消耗——更频繁地需要进入空间。
每一次进出，都像在透支他本就不多的力气。
但他不能停下。
黑土地里那六千株灵谷，是他唯一的活路。
他必须撑到它们成熟。
他只能更麻木地忍受鞭子，更沉默地接下活计，把每一丝能省下的力气都攒着，支撑到深夜进入空间的那片刻。
只有看到那些一天天拔高、一天天变黄的灵谷苗，那点希望之火才能勉强压住崩溃。
又熬过三天。
身上的伤更重了，头疼也成了常态，每天都是浑噩的。
糊糊喝下去，胃里依旧空，身体虚弱得走路发飘。
夜深。
陈平挣扎着坐起来，动作大了，扯着伤口，疼得他吸了口气。
content_en:
;;
Chen Ping woke up in the middle of the night and couldn't sleep.
pain.
The straw bunks of the shack were cold.
Chen Ping curled up on it, feeling sore all over.
The place on the back where the whip was torn was burning.
The skin on my shoulders, torn by the straps of the backpack, became scabbed and cracked, sticking to my clothes, causing pain when I moved.
There are many wounds on the hands, including cuts from cutting grass, abrasions from moving things, mixed with mud.
He closed his eyes, but couldn't sleep.
Brain aches.
Physically and mentally exhausted.
If this continues, he might die.
When I didn't have the jade pendant, life was hard, but I gritted my teeth and managed to finish my work without being whipped every day.
Ever since I got the jade pendant, especially when I frequently enter and leave the space, my whole spirit seems to have been drained.
If you work during the day, your hands and feet will become weak, your reaction will be slow, and your movements will be slower.
There is less grass to cut, the back is slower, and it is not easy to clean the pig pen.
The overseer's whip came down, and he didn't even have the strength to hide.
Manager Wang's face became more and more gloomy, and his scoldings became unpleasant.
Those brawny handymen even pushed the dirty work to him, and if they were slightly dissatisfied, they would punch and kick him.
The injuries on the body are new injuries stacked on top of old ones.
He knew he was stuck in a cycle.
Entering the space consumes energy - poor energy leads to slow work, beatings and injuries - physical injuries intensify the mental consumption - the need to enter the space more frequently.
Every time he went in and out, it seemed like he was overdrawing his little strength.
But he couldn't stop.
The six thousand spiritual valleys in the black earth were his only way to survive.
He had to hold on until they matured.
He could only endure the whip more numbly, take over the work more silently, save every ounce of energy he could spare, and hold on until the moment he entered the space late at night.
Only by seeing those spiritual grain seedlings that are growing taller and turning yellow day by day can the fire of hope barely suppress the collapse.
Another three days passed.
The injuries on his body became more serious, headaches became the norm, and he was confused every day.
After drinking the paste, my stomach was still empty and my body was so weak that I walked unsteadily.
Late at night.
Chen Ping struggled to sit up, his movements were too big, pulling at the wound, and the pain made him take a breath.
